display.name: Egnyte
display.summary: Searches and reads files, folders, and AI answers from Egnyte.

agent.name: egnyte
agent.description: Searches and reads Egnyte content visible to the signed-in user, including files, folders, document text, summaries, and available Egnyte Agents.
agent.owns: You own files and folders in Egnyte that this account can access. You only read and search; you do not upload, move, rename, or delete content. Some AI tools depend on the user's Egnyte plan.
agent.first_for: files and governed content stored in Egnyte

tool_descriptions.search: Search file names, indexed document content, and metadata and return ranked matches with snippets.
tool_descriptions.advanced_search: Search files and folders with path, date, type, metadata, namespace, similarity, and sorting filters.
tool_descriptions.fetch: Fetch the text of a document using the identifier returned by search.
tool_descriptions.get_file_content: Read the content of a file by its Egnyte path or identifier.
tool_descriptions.get_download_url: Create a temporary download URL for a file the signed-in user can access.
tool_descriptions.list_filesystem_by_path: List files and folders beneath an Egnyte filesystem path.
tool_descriptions.summarize_document: Generate an Egnyte AI summary of a specific document.
tool_descriptions.ask_document: Ask a question about one document and optionally return citations.
tool_descriptions.list_agents: List active Egnyte Agents created by or shared with the signed-in user.
tool_descriptions.get_agent_ask_status: Read the status and completed answer of a previously submitted Egnyte Agent request.
tool_descriptions.whoami: Return the authenticated Egnyte user's identity and domain information.
